content: Korneliuse Fitorore ḍakito defeṛaiye
Sizeriya šohorot Kornelius name ekzon manuš aššil. Hite aššilde Iṭalittu Romiyo šoinno dolor ofisar.
Hite ekzon allawala manuš, hitar góror beggune o Allare ḍoraito. Hite Ihudi gorib okkolore šome šome modot okkol dito, ar Allar hãse hamiša munazat gorito.
Ek din, dinor tinnwa baijjede ṭaimot maze hite ekkan deha faiye. Hite foriškar gori deikke ze Allar ekzon firista aiyore hitare ḍaker: "Kornelius!"
Korneliuse ḍoraiye edde he firistar mikka saiyore hodde, "Ki hodde, malik?" Firistaye hodde, "Tor munazat edde gorib okkolore modotor hota Allar hãse fõisse edde Allaye hin monot raikke.
Ehon tui Zaffa šohorot manuš defeṛai Simon, zare Fitor o ho, hitare ḍaki an.
Hite Simon name ek samora biyarir górot ase, ze górgan doriyar hãsat."
Ze firistaye Kornelius loi hota hoil hiba hentu giyegoi, bade Korneliuse duizon gulam edde ekzon nizor faharadari šoinnore ḍaikke.
Hite har hota buzaiye edde hitarare Zaffa šohorot defeṛaiye.
Tarforor din he manuš okkol fõt bai zaite zaite zẽtte Zaffa šohoror hãsa hãsi fõissegai, hẽtte ṭaim onumanik dũijja, Fitore sador uwore munazat goribolla uṭṭil.
Hibattu bug laigge edde kissu haito saiye, kintu hitara hehono hána tiyar gorat aššil, hetunot Fitor zurainna mikka abostat aššil.
He abostat maze Fitore dekedde asman kuli giyegoi edde hono kissu ekkan lami aiyer, hiyanore saite ekkan ḍõr saddor sair kuna loi duniyait lamai diya or.
He saddoror uwore hár ḍoilla sair ṭenga zanuwar edde buke aṛede zandar okkol edde faik okkol ase.
Tarfore ek abaze hibare hodde,
Fitore hodde: "No, no, Malik, hono mote no, kiyollahoile ãi hono din hono napak, oforiškar no hái."
Hetunot hibaye dusora bar ei abaz fuinne,

content.text: "Allaye zinore Pak goijje, hinore tui napak no hois."

content: Endilla tin bar oiye, toi bade he saddorgan abar asmanot tuli loi za oiye.
Fitore ze deha faiye hiyanor mani ki oitfare, ei babute hibaye ehono bafer, hen šomot Korneliuse defeṛaiyede manuššune Simonor gór tuwaiyore ehon dorozar sarme ai tiyaiyegai.
Tarfore hitara góror butore ḍak maijje edde fusar goijje, Simon, zare Fitor ḍaka o, hiba ki heṛe ase ne, hoi.
Fitore ehono o deha failde he babute bafat ase, toi Pak Ruhuye hibare hodde, "Sa, tinzon manuše tor talaš gorer.
Toratori gor, lamat za. Hono andeša no ani hitarar fũwati za, kiyollahoile hitarare ãi defeṛaiyide."
Toi Fitore lamiyore oi manuššunor hãse giye edde hodde: "So, tũwara zare talaš goror hiba ãi. Tũwara eṛe kiyolla aiššode?"

Hitara zuwabe hodde, "Ãrare šenafoti ofisar, Korneliuse defeṛaiyede. Hiba ekzon dormiyo manuš, ze Allare ḍora. Ar har Ihudi okkole hibar šunam gore. Hibaye ek Paki firistattu hokum faiye ze õnore hibar gõrot ḍaki loi zaiyore hibaye õnor hota fune."
Toi Fitore he manuš okkolore góror butore ḍaki ainne edde hitarare mehemandari goijje. Tarforor din uṛi hitarar fũwati giye. Ar Zaffa šohorottu ho ekzon torikotor báiyain hibar fisa fise giye.
Tarforor din hitara Sizeriyat fõissegoi. He šomot Korneliuse hitar nizor afonzon, egena, dusto okkolore ek zagat gori hitaralla entezar goijjil.
Bade Fitor zehon górot góille hetunot Korneliuse hibar loi deha oiye edde hibar ṭengot uitefori hibare soida goijje.
Kintu Fitore hitare tuli loiye, edde hodde: "Uṛi zagoi, ãi nize o bolke ekzon manuš."
Kornelius loi hota hoite hoite, Fitore butore zai sadde heṛe beša beši manuš okkol zoma oi taikke.

Hetunot Fitore hitarare hodde: "Õnora to zanode hota ze oinno hono zatir manuš loi aza gora ba hitarar loi dola owa ekzon Ihudilla iyan niyomor baire. Kintu ãre Allaye dehaiye ze honokiyore napak ba oforiškar howa bala no.
Hetolla tũwara zẽtte ãre ḍakito defeṛaila hẽtte hono bázá no raki ãi aišši. Kintu ãi ehon tũwarare fusar gori, tũwara ãre kiyolla ḍakito defeṛailade?"
Hetunot Kornileuse hodde: "Sair din age ṭik ei šomot, ãi ãr górot munazat goijjilam. Hen šomot atikka ekzon ujjol dola hor finda manuš ãr sarme aiyore tiyaiye.
Edde hodde, 'Kornelius, tor munazat edde gorib okkolore modotor hota Allar hãse fõisse edde Allaye hin monot raikke.
Ehon tui Zaffa šohorot manuš defeṛai Simon, zare Fitor o ḍaka o.hitare ḍaki ana. Hite Simon name ek samora biyarir górot ase, ze górgan doriyar hãsat.'
Hetolla ãi hehon õnore ḍaki anibolla manuš defeṛailam. Õne aiššode bala oiye. Ar ãra ehon beggune Allar sarme asi, Malike õnore ãrar hãse ziyan hoibolla hokum diye ãra hiyan funiyum."
Tarfore Fitore muk kuille edde hitarare hodde: "Soiyi ãi buzi faijji ze Allaye hono manušore forok no gore.
Kintu hár zatir butottu zara hibare ḍora edde ziyan hibar sukot ṭik hiyan ze gore, hitarare hibaye gose.
Tũwara zanode hota, Allaye ei kušir hóbor Israili okkolor hãse defeṛail, Isa Mosir duwara he šantir kušir hóbor, Isa Mosi, hiba ziba beggunor uwore Malik.
Tũwara beggune ei goṭona zano ze Yahyar duwara torikotor gusol tobolig gora oi bade Galilottu loti šuru gori šara Ehudiya agagura ei hóbor sorai gilgoi.

Ar Allaye kibafe Nasarator Isare Pak Ruh edde šokti diye, kibafe hibaye hár mikka giye edde bala ham okkol goijje, ar zara Šoitanor kobzar butore duk bug goitto, hitara beggunore aram gorito. Kiyollahoile hibar fũwati Allah aššil.
"Hibaye Ihudi okkolor dešot edde Zeruzalemot zin zin goijje hin beggunor goba oilamde ãra, hitara zara hibare kurušot loṭkaiyore mari felaiye.
Kintu Allaye hibare tin dinor din uwafes tuille, ar endilla goijje zene mainše hibare deke.
Hibare beggune no deke, kintu ze goba okkolore agottu loti Allaye basona goijjil hitarare deha diye. Hiba morattu uwafes uṛi zaigoi bade ãra hibar fũwati hafiya goijjilam.
Hibaye ãrare hokum diye, ãra zene tobolig gori edde goba di, ze Iba oilde he zon zibare Allaye zinda edde mora okkololla bisarhar hisabe buwaiye.
Hibar babute har nobi okkole goba der, ze honokiye hibar uwore biššaš ane, hite hibar namor duwara guna maf faibo."
Fitore ehono hota howat ase, hen šomot hitara zara he kalam funnil, hitara beggunor uwore Pak Ruh aiššiye.
Ze Ihudi biššaši okkol Fitoror fũwati aiššil hitara Oihudi okkolor uwore o Pak Ruhure hadiya hisabe ḍali diya oiyede deki tajjuf oiye.
Kiyollahoile zilor baša hodde edde Allar tarif goredde hitara fuinne. Toi Fitore hodde:
"Itara o ãrar ḍoilla Pak Ruhure faiye. Honokiye ki itarare torikotor gusol dite banda di faribo?"
Toi Fitore he manuš okkolore Isar name torikotor gusol dibolla hokum diye. Bade hitara Fitorore ho ek din hitarar hãse takibolla foriyad goijje.
